trap.label: inversão e tend
trap.wrong: Never it should be assumed that all agree.
trap.right: Never should it be assumed that all agree.
trap.why: O português não inverte. Em inglês formal, Never no início pede modal antes do sujeito.

mcq.q: Never ___ it be assumed that all agree.

rewrite.prompt: Comece com Never: “It should never be assumed that all agree.”
rewrite.answer: Never should it be assumed that all agree.

rewrite.prompt: Use tend to: “Teams often misread tone.”
Comece com Little: “He did not know.”
